newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain expects Iberia alliance by year end.
newsitem.headline: Spain expects Iberia alliance by year end.

text.p: Spain expects airline Iberia to form an alliance with a foreign company by the end of the year, Industry Ministry Josep Pique said on Tuesday.
"We hope to reach an agreement very soon, before year-end, not just a commercial one, but also one which would include a share swap," Pique told journalists.
Pique confirmed the existence of "intense negotiations" with foreign companies, such as British Airways, KLM and AMR Corp's American Airlines.

In the recent past, local press reports spoke of a possible alliance with Dutch airliner KLM. But there has also been speculation that Iberia could link up in a three-way mega-deal with BA and American.
Iberia made a net profit of 4.8 billion pesetas ($37.7 million) in July 1996, taking its net result for the first seven months of the year into positive territory for the first time in many years.
